profile.headline: Engineering @ S2 Global | Computer Science Graduate at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead a team responsible for the integration of AWS into our application, worked extensively with features such as cognito, S3Bucket, and remote Ec2 machines
• collaborated with other engineers, to design a java REST API for our backend server using SpringBoot.
• developed features for the frontend application using Swift and SwiftUI 
•Gained experience publishing and updating apps on the Apple App Store

positions.title: Scientific Computing Program
positions.locationName: Middle Island, New York, United States
positions.description:
•Developed software for various AWS cloud computer machines
•interfaced with various hardware and sensors to gather real time experimental data.
•Developed algorithms for data analysis of the data we collected.
